description: Read-only inventory before the Part 9 (#10) and Issue #27 probes: which of TK0100/TK0100D/LASTCD/SETENV/JUCSRV/ZAISRV/JUCHUM/JUCHUD/ZAIKOM/SHOHIM/TOKUIM/TANTOM exist in &LIB and &LIB2, the connection's library list and IBM i level, whether curl exists in PASE (P08 for 09-05), and a few 1-line SQL feature checks (JSON_OBJECT/JSON_TABLE, IFS_WRITE_UTF8, HTTP_GET, SEND_DATA_QUEUE) using catalog lookups only. No object is created, changed or deleted.

steps.sql: SELECT '&LIB' AS LIB, OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('TK0100','TK0100D','LASTCD','SETENV','JUCSRV','ZAISRV','JUCHUM','JUCHUD','ZAIKOM','SHOHIM','TOKUIM','TANTOM','JUCHUMV','TXSETUP','TXCHECK','ZAISRVBD') ORDER BY OBJNAME, OBJTYPE

SELECT '&LIB2' AS LIB, OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN ('TK0100','TK0100D','LASTCD','SETENV','JUCSRV','ZAISRV','JUCHUM','JUCHUD','ZAIKOM','SHOHIM','TOKUIM','TANTOM','JUCHUMV','TXSETUP','TXCHECK','ZAISRVBD') ORDER BY OBJNAME, OBJTYPE
SELECT '&LIB' AS LIB, COUNT(*) AS N FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X
SELECT SYSTEM_SCHEMA_NAME, SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME, FILE_TYPE FROM QSYS2.SYSTABLES WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA IN ('&LIB','&LIB2') AND TABLE_TYPE = 'P' FETCH FIRST 60 ROWS ONLY
SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, SCHEMA_NAME, TYPE FROM QSYS2.LIBRARY_LIST_INFO ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT ROUTINE_SCHEMA, ROUTINE_NAME, ROUTINE_TYPE FROM QSYS2.SYSROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA IN ('QSYS2','SYSTOOLS') AND ROUTINE_NAME IN ('HTTP_GET','HTTP_POST','IFS_WRITE_UTF8','IFS_WRITE','SEND_DATA_QUEUE','RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE','SEND_DATA_QUEUE_UTF8','SPOOLED_FILE_DATA','JSON_TABLE') ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('a':1, 'b':'x') AS J FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1
SELECT * FROM JSON_TABLE('{"a":[{"k":1},{"k":2}]}', 'lax $.a[*]' COLUMNS(K INT PATH 'lax $.k')) AS T
